title: John Grisham: Scott Colom Makes Me Proud of Mississippi
summary: As a kid, I once watched the Ku Klux Klan burn a cross in my hometown in Mississippi. Sixty years later, I look forward to shaking Mr. Colom’s hand and telling him I’m proud he’s my senator.
